item.title: EplayerX 1.2.13
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 修复切换服务器 STRM 设置后，详情页仍可能沿用旧播放地址的问题。 - 改善下载准备阶段的取消与重试，避免队列卡住或后续任务无法开始。 - 修复手动校正媒体信息后，已有电影或剧集分类可能被拆分的问题。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What's New
- Fixed detail pages sometimes reusing outdated playback URLs after changing a server's STRM setting. - Improved cancellation and retry during download preparation to prevent stalled queues and blocked tasks. - Fixed existing movie or TV show collections being split after manually correcting media metadata.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
